derivation.method: The SDK contains the raw bytes of the product-owned PontxSpec only. It does not vendor the supplier OpenAPI document.
derivation.identifierNormalization: 110 official dashed operationIds and 6 dashed Schema names were normalized to valid camelCase identifiers in the canonical PontxSpec (matching OpenAI's own official SDK naming); all $ref pointers were rewritten deterministically.

execution.credentialBoundary: OpenAI API keys (and admin API keys where required) remain caller-local; they are read only from options or environment variables and never exposed through previews, errors, or logs.
execution.mutationPolicy: The generated CLI requires a redacted dry-run and an exact request-bound --confirm token for POST and DELETE calls.
